name: MONODRONE
author: Michael
tagline: drones for the end of the world
description: Four layers of drone, each a latched chord of up to four voices on one of twelve engines, into one chain of dirt, filter, tape delay and reverb. No sequencer: you set things running, bend them live and move between sixteen scenes, each with its own animated 1-bit place. Twelve punch effects on the keys, eight macros that move many settings at once, MIDI in over USB and TRS, and the output recordable over USB.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
